answer.thought: I am already home, seated on the veranda. The bookseller's voice is a memory, a phantom limb of the afternoon. The air is 23 degrees, cool enough to think without the sweat of labor. I have no money to spend, no food to cook, and a file waiting in the ether. I will sit in the darkening room and let the day end.
